text.tspan: Avoid exposure to extreme temperatures and
abrasive materials like sand. Never expose the train
map to water. If it has been in contact with water
do not try to dry it in rice. Keep it powered off and
place it in a warm, dry place (less than 80°C) for at
least a few days before powering it on again.
